**Document Summary**

This document appears to be a part of the Model Building Regulations for Town Municipal Administration in 2007. It outlines the requirements for submitting plans and documents related to building constructions, including residential and multi-storey buildings.

The document covers various aspects such as:

* Documents of Title (e.g., title documents, allotment/transfer orders, lease agreements)
* Site Plan requirements
* Building plan preparation and submission
* Approval procedures for builders and architects
* Additional documents required for multi-storey buildings and public assembly buildings

Specifically, it mentions the need for a Structure Stability Certificate, structural design drawings, and soil investigation reports.

**Key Takeaway**

This document primarily focuses on the regulatory requirements for building constructions in the specified jurisdiction. It provides guidance on what documents must be submitted to support building plans and ensure compliance with local regulations.

For new structure, plans and documents which shall be submitted along the notice are listed 
below: -

carry out such work.

b. Site Plan  
i. A site plan drawn to a scale of 100 ft (30.49m) to an inch (0.03m) (1:1250) to show the 
site to which it refers, unless its address is a number in a regular sequence of numbers in an 
Approved Scheme.  
ii. A block plan of the site drawn to a scale of not le ss than 32 ft (9.76m) to an inch (0.03m) 
(1:400) showing the position of the proposed building and existing buildings, if any;the 
width and level of the streets on which the plot abuts and the adjoining plot numbers 
together with cardinal points.

10.3.3 Multi Storey Buildings and Buildings of Public Assembly  
 
 In addition to the plans and documents as specified in sections 10.3.1&10.3.2, the builder shall 
submit the following documents:  
 
a. Structure Stability Certificate  
A structure stability certificate signed by a qualified Structure Engineer along with building 
plans of multi -storey buildings and buildings of public assembly on performa BB -6. 
 
b. Structural Design Drawings  
Three sets of structural design and documents as listed below duly prepared and signed by a 
consulting Structural Engineer.  
 
i. Design criteria, specifying design loads, reference standards and codes, and the methods 
of analysis and design adopted.  
ii. Design computations  
iii. Design drawings  
iv. Relevant technical specifications  
v. Soil investigation report.
